name: Kobee Studio
description: Create parametric PCB labels, icons, header overlays, QR Codes, and barcodes inside KiCad
description_full: Kobee Studio creates editable PCB artwork on silkscreen, copper, and solder-mask layers. It includes parametric labels, PCB symbols, searchable presets, configurable 2.54 mm header overlays, QR Codes, and Code 128 barcodes. Kobee Studio evolved from KiBuzzard by Greg Davill. Version 1.0 is tested with KiCad 10 on macOS; Windows and Linux validation is planned.
